reuse.why: The new getDateWithWeekendRule wraps and reuses the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move case, and all callers keep using getNextDate/RSchedule as before.

duplication.why: The weekend rule is centralised, and the duplicated skipWeekend ternary in schedule-template is collapsed into a local helper, but the 'scan DAILY_SCAN_WINDOW occurrences and drop skipped ones' pattern is written twice (getNextDate and getUpcomingDates).

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing weekend helper, frequency is threaded through the schedule data built in rule-utils, and server callers only consume it.

scope.why: Only the three weekend-handling call sites, the rule data and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: One named rule function with a clear null contract is easy to own; the scan-window constant and the null-aware loop in schedule-template add some subtlety.

disguised_duplication.where: The scan-window-and-filter in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) is similar but openly uses the shared constant and rule; not disguised.

one_place.where: getDateWithWeekendRule in shared/schedules.ts is used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (schedule-template.ts).
